description: Searches the free browser games listed on Foundplay, made by independent creators, many of them with AI tools. Matches the query against each game's title, one-line description and genres. Returns catalog device and multiplayer facts, counted outbound clicks, upvotes, creator credit and Foundplay page links. Read-only. Defaults to most played; best uses the website's quality ranking and returns its method and limits, not a hands-on review. The optional aiMade filter requires recorded AI-creation provenance.

aiMade.description: true requires recorded evidence of AI-assisted creation, using the website's AI-made list rules. False or omitted does not filter by AI use; missing evidence is unknown.

limit.description: How many games to return. Default 8.

multiplayer.description: true for catalog multiplayer support, online or on one screen. Does not guarantee online play or a particular player count.

phone.description: true for catalog phone support, such as touch controls. Not a physical-device test or a guarantee for every iPhone, Android device or browser.

query.description: Words required in the title, description or genre, such as 'zombie shooter' or 'cozy farm'. Use phone and aiMade flags for those constraints instead of adding them as query words. Leave empty or omit for broad discovery with filters.

sort.description: popular (all-time counted clicks, the default), trending (last 48 hours), new (newest Foundplay listings, not original release dates), or best (the website's quality ranking of eligible originals).

name: search_games

aiMadeFilter.description: Present when aiMade is true, including when no games match.

canonicalUrl.description: AI-made reference list, narrowed to the AI-phone list when phone is also true. Other request constraints are not applied to this reference page.

apiSearch.description: Public JSON search self-link retaining text, sort, limit, genre, phone, multiplayer and AI-made filters. Public assistant eligibility applies; no owner authorization is included.

browseAll.description: Broader website Browse destination preserving only its supported filters. See browseAllMeaning; it is not the same eligible result set.

browseAllMeaning.description: Which request choices the broader website Browse link preserves and which it does not.

aiMadeEvidence.description: Present only for aiMade:true. The recorded signal and public source, not proof of a specific AI workflow or a code audit.

sourceUrl.description: Public context for the recorded signal, not an independent code verification. Jam and host pages may not name every matched game.

canonicalUrl.description: The same game page without attribution parameters.

listedAt.description: When this listing was added to Foundplay, in ISO 8601 UTC. Not the game's original release date or a gameplay/device test date.

multiplayer.description: Catalog flag: true for multiplayer, false for single-player, null if unknown. Multiplayer can be online or on one screen; this does not specify a player count.

phoneFriendly.description: Catalog flag: true for phone support, false for keyboard/computer, null if unknown. Not a physical-device test or a guarantee for every phone or browser.

plays.description: All-time counted outbound Play clicks, including when sort is trending. Not confirmed gameplay or unique people. See playsMeaning.

qualityTier.description: Present for best order: the catalog's signal-based tier, not a review rating.

url.description: The game's page on Foundplay, with a Play button.

listsMeaning.description: Related lists match by title; their contents are not restricted by the game's requested filters.

phoneFilter.description: Present when phone is true, including empty results. Describes recorded support and its limits.

canonicalUrl.description: The general phone-games reference list; other request constraints are not applied to this page.

playsMeaning.description: How the public play count is measured and what it does not establish.

ranking.description: Present for best order, including when no eligible game matches.

total.description: How many games matched in all.

title: Search browser games
